questions.scenario: You hear about a bizarre new street-food trend (like a viral flying cheese vada pav) exploding on Instagram reels in your city. What do you do?

options.A: Rush to the stall immediately to try it while the hype is at its peak, before the trend completely dies down next week.
options.B: Look up online reviews, check their hygiene ratings, and analyze if the taste genuinely justifies the high price tag.
options.C: Wait for a few weeks to see if any of your friends get a stomach ache or give bad reviews before you risk your money.
options.D: Look at all the top trending food stalls in your area and map out a food-walk that balances sweet, spicy, and savory options perfectly.

questions.scenario: During the IPL season, your friends invite you to a local fantasy cricket league. How do you pick your players?

options.A: Pick players who are in screaming hot form *today* and aggressively change your captain minutes before the toss based on the pitch report.
options.B: Spend hours studying past player records, how they perform against specific bowlers, and their long-term batting averages.
options.C: Choose safe, reliable all-rounders so that even if your star batsmen get out for a duck, your overall points don't completely crash.
options.D: Build a highly balanced squad consisting of a mix of aggressive young hitters, steady test players, and premium bowlers to win the full tournament.

questions.scenario: The big Amazon/Flipkart festive sale is live, but prices are fluctuating every single hour. How do you shop for your new shoes?

options.A: Keep refreshing the page every 5 minutes, waiting for a sudden flash drop to instantly hit 'Buy Now' before stocks run out.
options.B: Read 10 detailed tech/style reviews, compare prices across three different websites, and wait for the logical bottom price.
options.C: Set a strict maximum spending alert on your banking app and ensure the item has an easy '7-day return policy' in case something goes wrong.
options.D: Divide your festive budget across footwear, apparel, and a gadget accessory, making sure you don't spend everything on just one item.

questions.scenario: Your relatives give you a heavy amount of Shagun cash (e.g., ₹5,000) altogether for your birthday or Diwali. What is your plan?

options.A: Put it into a trendy peer-to-peer online tournament or a fast-moving sneaker resell deal to try and double it by this weekend.
options.B: Investigate which premium online skill course or high-quality sports gear will give you the highest utility and value for years to come.
options.C: Put most of it safely inside your bank account or a fixed deposit, keeping only a tiny fraction out for minor daily expenses.
options.D: Divide the cash into three distinct buckets: one for an instant celebration party, one for books, and one saved for a major purchase next year.

questions.scenario: You are playing a highly competitive game of Monopoly or 'Business' with your cousins on a rainy Sunday afternoon. What is your winning style?

options.A: Make lightning-fast property trades and flip assets continuously, trying to pocket quick cash on small deals before anyone else notices.
options.B: Focus solely on acquiring the premium, high-rent properties because you know they yield the best compound returns in the late game.
options.C: Refuse to buy properties if it leaves you low on cash, always keeping a massive emergency cash reserve to pay sudden fines or rent.
options.D: Spread your ownership across utilities, railways, and a mix of low and high-cost color sets so you collect steady rent from every corner of the board.

questions.scenario: You and your squad are planning a weekend movie outing, but tickets are selling fast and prices are dynamic. How do you handle booking?

options.A: Monitor the ticketing app constantly and snap up the corner seats the exact second a sudden flash discount code pops up.
options.B: Check the IMDb scores, audience reviews, and director interviews first to make absolutely sure the film isn't a box-office flop.
options.C: Make every friend transfer their exact share to your UPI account *before* you book, ensuring you aren't stuck with an expensive bill if someone cancels.
options.D: Coordinate the entire plan—movie tickets, food court combos, and auto-rickshaw fares—ensuring the total plan stays within everyone's varying budgets.

questions.scenario: A local tuition teacher or coaching class is suddenly getting flooded with admissions from your school. What goes through your mind?

options.A: Join a trial class immediately this week to see if you can catch up on whatever secret short-cuts they are teaching before the unit tests.
options.B: Dig up their past board-exam toppers' history, analyze their study material, and judge if their method actually matches your style.
options.C: Check if they offer a flexible monthly payment option or a partial refund scheme just in case the teacher changes midway through the year.
options.D: Assess your own weak subjects across Science, Math, and English, and decide if spending your tuition budget here is the best use of your total resources.

questions.scenario: Your school class is organizing a Secret Santa or an anonymous gift exchange with a strict budget cap. How do you pick your gift?

options.A: Wait until the absolute last evening to run to the local market and buy whatever cool, trending novelty item is flying off the shelves.
options.B: Secretly find out the recipient's personal hobbies or favorite anime characters to order a meaningful, highly specific item.
options.C: Track your expenses down to the last single rupee, making sure the gift, wrapping paper, and ribbon together do not cross the limit by even 50 paise.
options.D: Curate a custom combo pack containing a small book, a good pen, and a premium chocolate, ensuring that they will definitely love at least one part of it.

questions.scenario: A new homegrown local brand wants you and your friends to promote their funky customized school bags for a cash commission. How do you react?

options.A: Sign up immediately and blast the product links across all your school WhatsApp groups to make lightning-fast pocket money this weekend.
options.B: Closely test the quality of the zippers, stitch strength, and fabric first to make sure your friends won't blame you for selling junk.
options.C: Read through the commission rules carefully to ensure the brand has a transparent tracking system and can't cheat you out of your hard-earned payouts.
options.D: Organize your friend group into a small team—assigning one to social media handles, one to talk to juniors, and one to manage the collected cash.

questions.scenario: Your smartphone or computer screen flashes a 'Storage Almost Full' warning. What is your method to clean up?

options.A: Quickly delete all temporary files, clear massive app caches, and wipe out large videos right now so you can install a new game instantly.
options.B: Go through your gallery slowly, keeping only the high-quality notes and essential family photographs, archiving everything else systematically.
options.C: Back up your entire device onto a secure external pen drive or a private cloud account first, verifying everything is safe before deleting a single file.
options.D: Categorize your entire device into strict, clean folders—separating study PDFs, game data, music, and personal media for balanced future access.

Role_1.title: Day Trader / Scalper
Role_1.primary_match_text: You are the lightning-fast action hero of the markets! You thrive under immense adrenaline, make split-second decisions, and love capturing quick profits from fast-moving trends before others even wake up.
Role_1.day_in_the_life: Sitting in front of multi-screen setups with live price charts, analyzing rapid technical indicators, executing dozens of trades a day, and exiting the market before the closing bell rings.
Role_1.alternative_match_text: Your high-speed decision-making and comfort with fast-paced environments also make you an excellent fit for Esports, Auction Management, or Live Event Production.
Role_1.educational_roadmap: Choose Commerce or Science with Mathematics in 11th/12th. Pursue a degree in B.Com (Finance), BBA, or a quantitative field. Proactively take up NISM (National Institute of Securities Markets) certifications like Series VIII (Equity Derivatives) and practice on virtual trading simulators early to master price action without risking real cash.

Role_2.title: Equity Research Analyst / Fundamental Investor
Role_2.primary_match_text: You are a deep-thinking market detective! You don't care about temporary hype; you love researching the core facts, reading between the lines, and discovering high-quality assets built for long-term success.
Role_2.day_in_the_life: Reading complex company annual reports, analyzing economic sectors, tracking corporate earnings calls, and writing detailed research reports recommending which stocks or assets are genuinely undervalued.
Role_2.alternative_match_text: Your masterful research abilities and logical approach make you highly suitable for Management Consulting, Business Journalism, or Market Intelligence Roles.
Role_2.educational_roadmap: Take up Commerce with Math or Economics in 11th/12th standard. Target premium undergraduate degrees like B.Com (Hons), B.A. in Economics, or BBA (Finance). Post graduation, clearing the globally recognized CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) Level 1 or pursuing an MBA in Finance will make you a highly sought-after research asset.

Role_3.title: Risk Manager / Quantitative Analyst
Role_3.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate financial shield! While everyone else dreams of making profits, you possess the rare superpower of ensuring the team doesn't lose what it already has. You think mathematically and keep a cool head.
Role_3.day_in_the_life: Using complex statistical models to predict worst-case market scenarios, setting strict stop-loss rules, ensuring traders comply with financial laws, and protecting millions of dollars from sudden market crashes.
Role_3.alternative_match_text: Your math-heavy mindset and defensive strategy instincts make you a perfect candidate for Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, or Cybersecurity Risk Auditing.
Role_3.educational_roadmap: Opt for Science or Commerce strictly with Mathematics/Statistics in 11th/12th standard. Pursue an undergraduate degree in B.Sc (Statistics/Mathematics), B.Tech, or B.Com (Hons). Later, aim for the highly respected FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification or pursue a master's degree in Quantitative Finance.

Role_4.title: Portfolio Manager / Fund Strategist
Role_4.primary_match_text: You are the grand master of the financial chessboard! You look at the complete, big-picture ecosystem and expertly blend different assets together to build a robust, weather-proof money machine.
Role_4.day_in_the_life: Allocating capital across diverse asset classes like Indian equities, gold, international indices, and fixed-income assets, meeting high-net-worth clients, and balancing total portfolio risk to achieve steady, generational wealth creation.
Role_4.alternative_match_text: Your balanced asset-management mindset and big-picture strategy skills translate wonderfully into Venture Capital, Project Management, or Corporate Strategy.
Role_4.educational_roadmap: Opt for 11th/12th Commerce or Science with a strong focus on Mathematics/Economics. Complete your graduation in B.Com, BBA (Finance), or Economics (Hons). To gain the authority to manage public funds in India, aim for a post-graduate MBA in Finance from top-tier institutes (like IIMs) or the complete CFA Charter, followed by SEBI-registered certifications.
